title: Guided empty state
description: The EmptyState variant “guided” (L13): the first use of a page that needs a few steps before it is useful. A step carousel (“Bước 1 / 4”, a visual, ‹ ›) or numbered steps, the one primary action, a link to the full guide, and rows of ready starting points by category, each with “Xem tất cả”.
when: First use of a page whose value needs setup in a few steps (suppliers before quotes, a catalogue before orders).
A first use with ready starting points (import from Excel, find in DataHub, templates by category).

instead.need: First use that one action fills
A search or filter matched nothing
Introduce a new feature to people who already use the page

a11y: The guide is a region named by the title (an h2, headingLevel to change); a step change is read from a polite live region. At an end the pressed arrow turns disabled and focus moves to the other one.
Starting points are links (href) or buttons in a list under an h3 per category; “Xem tất cả” is a link or a button.

examples.title: Numbered steps
examples.description: layout="steps": every step at once, for two to four short steps.

notes: One filled button on the screen: hide the page's own primary while the guided state shows (§13).
Below sm the guide card follows the phone cap (at most 40% of the screen, the visual hidden, scrolls inside); the starting points become one row that scrolls sideways.
